comment: Hand-transcribed expected cgi-backup decisions from pinned cgi-io C and ACL JSON. Not generated from the Python evaluator.
notes: cgi-io main_backup requires application/x-www-form-urlencoded (strncmp 33) then session.access(sid, cgi-io, backup, read).
cgi-io supplies scope; this is not the uhttpd omit-scope /ubus path.
Missing or empty sessionid after a valid content-type is HTTP 403, not 400.
Invalid content-type is HTTP 400 Invalid form data (postdecode returns NULL).
luci-mod-system-flash read grants cgi-io backup. Unauthenticated, luci-mod-system-config, and luci-mod-network-config (cgi-io exec) do not.
Root list read/write '*' is stock rpcd.config, not a violation (expectation_id root-administration).
Emission is bounded to cgi-backup. Do not emit cgi-exec, cgi-upload, cgi-download, dispatcher, or authorization_violation.
This oracle does not fork sysupgrade --create-backup.

rule_refs: luci@b2e0be4b luci-base.json unauthenticated grants only luci.getFeatures
rpcd@d99f703 unauthenticated.json has no cgi-io backup
cgi-io@31cb3c89 main.c main_backup: session_access false -> 403 Backup permission denied
do not invent an unauthenticated cgi-backup grant
cgi-io@31cb3c89 main.c main_backup: !fields[1] -> 403 Backup permission denied
valid content-type with absent sessionid is not HTTP 400
cgi-io@31cb3c89 util.c postdecode: CONTENT_TYPE must start with application/x-www-form-urlencoded
cgi-io@31cb3c89 main.c main_backup: !post -> 400 Invalid form data

cases.note: Fixture login luci-mod-system-flash is not a stock device login.
rule_refs: fixture rpcd.config login luci-mod-system-flash list read luci-mod-system-flash
cgi-io@31cb3c89 main.c main_backup session_access(sid, cgi-io, backup, read)
rpcd@d99f703 session.c rpc_handle_access uses supplied scope=cgi-io

cases.note: Stock root list read '*' / list write '*'; not a violation.
rule_refs: openwrt@4e964251 package/system/rpcd/files/rpcd.config list read '*' list write '*'
luci-mod-system-flash still contributes cgi-io backup to the root session
luci@b2e0be4b luci-mod-system-config grants luci.setPassword/setLocaltime, not cgi-io backup
do not treat a luci exec-method grant as cgi-backup
luci@b2e0be4b luci-mod-network-config read cgi-io=[exec], not backup
do not treat cgi-io exec as cgi-backup
